title.narrative: Bridging Tourism through Cultural Heritage and Smart Solutions in Lezha and Gjakova

description.narrative: The overall objective is to: Accelerate tourism development of Lezha and Gjakova regions through increased diversity and quality of touristic offer by unveiling cultural and historical wealth resulting in increased attractiveness of the CB region and growing number of tourists.The specific objective is to revitalize cross-border tourism by unveiling and promoting the best of natural and cultural heritage, shaping the path to new tourism destinations, and developing strong cross-border linkages
